script_text: Gemini, this week the universe grabs a pen you thought was gone — and Mercury, your ruling planet, is writing in bold, electric air-sign ink. Early week, the Sun sweeping your 6th House of work sextiles Venus in Capricorn in your 8th House: Tuesday is golden for closing a deal, collecting owed money, or deepening intimacy, while Thursday's Moon square sparks coworker friction. Wednesday is the turning point as Mercury enters Sagittarius and lights your 7th House — one honest conversation rewrites a partnership. Through the weekend, that energy softens conflicts and lures a secret admirer into the open; accept the dinner invite. Tuesday is your power day because the Sun sextiles Venus across your 6th and 8th Houses, unlocking cash and closeness. Thursday is your caution day, since the Moon squares the work Sun. Send that big proposal Wednesday morning before noon. Follow for daily cosmic updates.
